summary: Clearer Puppy responses and safer private-agent conversations.

improvements: Puppy keeps the answering device’s model visible after a response.
Files organization preserves the original filename while allowing reversible display names.
Updates from the qualified earlier release preserve Files, conversations and private-agent settings.
fixes: Puppy distinguishes device timeouts from private-agent deadlines.
Conversation refreshes ignore stale owner and vault sessions.
A failed conversation deletion preserves the unsent draft and attachments.
security: Existing private agents require a qualified image transition and exact owner approval.
Files analysis remains opt-in; Computer Use stays disabled until its cloud gates pass.
